Airton is an MVP for a business prospection tool.

It combines information open businneess data with AI to help users identify potential clients and business opportunities. The tool provides insights into market trends, competitor analysis, and customer behavior, enabling businesses to make informed decisions and optimize their sales strategies.


This repo will contain the code for the MVP, both at frontend and backend.


## Tech Stack

This will be hosted on Cloudfare.

Cloudfare Workers AI on the backend will deal with the AI processing and data analysis.

Cloudfare Pages will host the frontend, which will be built using Nuxt UI


## MVP

MVP will be built in phases.
